item.title: U of I team develops innovative water treatment system
item.description: CHAMPAIGN-URBANA, Ill. (WCIA) -- Certain nutrients that wash into water from agricultural fields has been shown to pollute that water and fuel harmful algal blooms. But, researchers with the University of Illinois may have created a cost-effective solution. The scientists created a new edge-of-field treatment system by combining woodchip bioreactors with a two-step biochar water-treatment module. [...]

item.description: TOLONO, Ill. (WCIA) - Unity senior wrestler Phoenix Molina was named the WCIA 3 Athlete of the Week on Thursday.
